subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should the Control UI intentionally change Nostr Import from immediate persistence to a reviewable draft requiring Save & Publish, while explicit HTTP `autoMerge: true` remains supported?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but tests cannot decide whether the observable persistence-workflow change is the intended compatibility policy for existing Control UI users.

options.title: Confirm Draft Semantics
options.body: Accept the safer review-before-persist workflow and retain explicit HTTP auto-merge compatibility for other callers.

options.title: Preserve Implicit Persistence
options.body: Do not merge this behavior until the UI offers a separate explicit import-and-save action or another owner-approved compatibility design.

recommendation.title: Confirm Draft Semantics
recommendation.body: Accept the safer review-before-persist workflow and retain explicit HTTP auto-merge compatibility for other callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest connection to the original Nostr profile surface and its subsequent mutation-policy maintenance.
